data.name: G3L1_001
data.value: (The door is locked.)

data.name: G3L1_002
data.value: This is the top level of the guild.[pause=0] This is where guild members work and live.

data.name: G3L1_003
data.value: The Guildmaster's office is just over here.[pause=0] Please come with me.

data.name: G3L1_004
data.value: Please wait here.[pause=0] I am going to notify the Guildmaster of your arrival.

data.name: G3L1_005
data.value: OK![pause=0] We'll wait right here!

data.name: G3L1_006
data.value: Very good.[pause=0] I shall return momentarily.

data.name: G3L1_007
data.value: Wow![pause=0] I can't believe we're about to meet the Guildmaster!

data.name: G3L1_008
data.value: The first time I came here I only met with {0}.[pause=0] I didn't get to see the Guildmaster!

data.name: G3L1_009
data.value: He's a world famous adventurer![pause=0] And we're going to meet him!

data.name: G3L1_010
data.value: I knew we'd have to see him eventually...[pause=0] But I'm still starstruck![script=0]

data.name: G3L1_011
data.value: I don't know if I should be estatic or if I should be panicking!

data.name: G3L1_012
data.value: I think I'm doing both!?[pause=0] And I think my face is stuck!?

data.name: G3L1_013
data.value: You're right,[pause=10] you're right...[pause=0] But I'm all wound up!

data.name: G3L1_014
data.value: This is the moment I've been waiting my whole life for![pause=0] It's got me all fidgety!

data.name: G3L1_015
data.value: I'm not sure I can turn it off,[pause=10] but I can try...

data.name: G3L1_016
data.value: Well,[pause=10] my face isn't stuck anymore,[pause=10] but I still feel tingly with anticipation...

data.name: G3L1_017
data.value: Do we really have what it takes?[pause=0] Do I really have what it takes?

data.name: G3L1_018
data.value: And what if we're rejected?[pause=0] I don't know if I could handle that...

data.name: G3L1_019
data.value: Yeah![pause=0] You're right!

data.name: G3L1_020
data.value: I shouldn't have so much doubt in us![pause=0] I think we can really do it now!

data.name: G3L1_021
data.value: I'm still a little nervous but...[pause=0] I don't feel as anxious anymore.

data.name: G3L1_022
data.value: I really needed to hear those words.[pause=0] Thank you,[pause=10] {0}.

data.name: G3L1_023
data.value: I'm excited to meet the Guildmaster,[pause=10] but...

data.name: G3L1_024
data.value: I'm also kinda intimidated.[pause=0] I've got butterflies in my stomach again...

data.name: G3L1_025
data.value: I feel so uneasy about this...[pause=0] Do you really think they'll let us join,[pause=10] {0}?

data.name: G3L1_026
data.value: You really think so?

data.name: G3L1_027
data.value: I still feel a little apprehensive...[pause=0] But if you have confidence,[pause=10] then I should too!

data.name: G3L1_028
data.value: As long as I do my best to keep my nerves in check,[pause=10] I'm sure we'll do fine!

data.name: G3L1_029
data.value: I apologize for the delay.[pause=0] I had some matters to discuss with the Guildmaster.

data.name: G3L1_030
data.value: He is ready to see the two of you.[pause=0] Please come with me into his quarters.

data.name: G3L2_001
data.value: She will teach you the basics of adventuring and dungeoneering.

data.name: G3L2_002
data.value: Once you leave the guild,[pause=10] go over the bridge and head east.

data.name: G3L2_003
data.value: There is a ladder that will lead down into a cave,[pause=10] where the dojo is located.

data.name: G3L2_004
data.value: You should prepare yourselves with the proper facilities in town,[pause=10] then head north to search for {0}.

data.name: G3L2_005
data.value: If you manage to find him,[pause=10] please bring him back to town immediately.

data.name: G3L2_006
data.value: Alright,[pause=10] looks like we have everyone now.

data.name: G3L2_007
data.value: Howdy Pokémon![pause=0] If you don't already know,[pause=10] we have new recruits!

data.name: G3L2_008
data.value: Everyone,[pause=10] please give a warm welcome to Team {0},[pause=10] {1} and {2}!

data.name: G3L2_009
data.value: Oh![pause=0] Thank you everyone!

data.name: G3L2_010
data.value: Be sure to treat them with the same respect and kindness you'd treat any other apprentice with!

data.name: G3L2_011
data.value: But that goes without saying of course!

data.name: G3L2_012
data.value: Well,[pause=10] there's nothing else on the docket.[pause=0] That's the only announcement for today!

data.name: G3L2_013
data.value: But before we start today's work,[pause=10] what do we always say?

data.name: G3L2_014
data.value: One for all...

data.name: G3L2_015
data.value: AND ALL FOR ONE!

data.name: G3L2_016
data.value: Alright Pokémon,[pause=10] let's get to the day's adventures!

data.name: G3L2_017
data.value: HURRAH!

data.name: G3L2_018
data.value: Team {0},[pause=10] would you come speak with me for a moment please?

data.name: G3L2_019
data.value: How are you two doing?[pause=0] Sleep well last night?[pause=0] Get acquainted with any of the apprentices yet?

data.name: G3L2_020
data.value: Yup![pause=0] The room and beds you gave us are great!

data.name: G3L2_021
data.value: We went around yesterday and introduced ourselves to all the other apprentices too!

data.name: G3L2_022
data.value: I'm glad to hear that![pause=0] Seems like you're settling in fine then!

data.name: G3L2_023
data.value: On to business...[pause=0] As it's your first day,[pause=10] allow me to explain how your guild training will work.

data.name: G3L2_024
data.value: Every morning,[pause=10] after the daily meeting,[pause=10] {0} will give you an assignment for the day.

data.name: G3L2_025
data.value: This could be taking requests from the boards downstairs or tasks {0} comes up with for you.

data.name: G3L2_026
data.value: Make sure to speak with him before you leave for the day and that you do whatever he asks of you!

data.name: G3L2_027
data.value: If you have any trouble,[pause=10] you can always ask any of your fellow guild members for help...[pause=0] Including me!

data.name: G3L2_028
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] and we have dinner just after sunset,[pause=10] so make it back by then if you want to have {0}'s cooking!

data.name: G3L2_029
data.value: Now,[pause=10] {0},[pause=10] if you would?[pause=0] I've got to get some work done in my office.

data.name: G3L2_030
data.value: Of course,[pause=10] Guildmaster.

data.name: G3L2_031
data.value: As you heard from the Guildmaster,[pause=10] I will be leading your training initiative.

data.name: G3L2_032
data.value: Since you are inexperienced,[pause=10] I would like you to go to Ledian Dojo and take the basic lesson with Sensei {0}.

data.name: G3L2_033
data.value: Ledian Dojo?

data.name: G3L2_034
data.value: Ledian Dojo is a local training facility.[pause=0] Please speak with the sensei there and request the basic lesson.

data.name: G3L2_035
data.value: She will teach you the basics of adventuring and dungeoneering.

data.name: G3L2_036
data.value: It is imperative that you learn these skills before you do any actual adventuring work.

data.name: G3L2_037
data.value: Once you leave the guild,[pause=10] go over the bridge and head east.

data.name: G3L2_038
data.value: There is a ladder that will lead down into a cave,[pause=10] where the dojo is located.

data.name: G3L2_039
data.value: Aww...[pause=0] I was hoping to do something a little more exciting...[pause=0] But we are new I guess...

data.name: G3L2_040
data.value: Oh well...[pause=0] {0},[pause=10] we'll head right over to the dojo.

data.name: G3L2_041
data.value: Very good.[pause=0] Make sure not to come back to the guild too late or you will miss dinner.

data.name: G3L2_042
data.value: Hey,[pause=10] it's the new guys![pause=0] How was your first day on the job?

data.name: G3L2_043
data.value: It was good![pause=0] We trained at Ledian Dojo today.

data.name: G3L2_044
data.value: Awesome![pause=0] You'll be exploring ancient ruins and saving Pokémon in danger in no time!

data.name: G3L2_045
data.value: Haha,[pause=10] thanks![pause=0] I sure hope so!

data.name: G3L2_046
data.value: What are you two up to out here then?

data.name: G3L2_047
data.value: {0} and I are waiting out here until {1} finishes cooking dinner.

data.name: G3L2_048
data.value: We would wait at the dinner table,[pause=10] but {0} insists that nobody watch her while she cooks.

data.name: G3L2_049
data.value: She doesn't want anyone disturbing her while she's "making art".

data.name: G3L2_050
data.value: She talked big about her food yesterday,[pause=10] but I didn't think she would go that far.

data.name: G3L2_051
data.value: Yup,[pause=10] {0} takes her cooking very seriously.

data.name: G3L2_052
data.value: I wish she didn't take so long though to finish dinner.

data.name: G3L2_053
data.value: We've been waiting for quite a bit now![pause=0] {0} and I are starving!

data.name: G3L2_055
data.value: It's worth the wait though.[pause=0] I don't know how she does it,[pause=10] but she makes great meals.

data.name: G3L2_056
data.value: Sometimes I even try to sneak in a midnight snack of some of the leftovers,[pause=10] heheh!

data.name: G3L2_057
data.value: Looks like a few other guild members are waiting around here for dinner.

data.name: G3L2_058
data.value: Everyone![pause=0] Your attention please!

data.name: G3L2_059
data.value: My latest work of art is ready for the public.[pause=0] Follow me for the viewing,[pause=10] if you would. {0}

data.name: G3L2_060
data.value: HOORAY!

data.name: G3L2_061
data.value: That's just how {0} lets everyone know it's dinnertime.

data.name: G3L2_062
data.value: Oh.[pause=0] That's a bit odd,[pause=10] but I guess I understand now.[pause=0] Well,[pause=10] in that case...

data.name: G3L2_063
data.value: Let's eat!

data.name: G3L2_064
data.value: Ah,[pause=10] Team {0}.

data.name: G3L2_065
data.value: Please follow me.[pause=0] I will show you to your assignment for today.

data.name: G3L2_066
data.value: Come on {0}![pause=0] We need to get back to {1} to find {2}!

data.name: G3L2_067
data.value: WELCOME!!!

data.name: G3L2_068
data.value: She's v-very prideful when it comes to her cooking.[pause=0] She considers each meal she makes a work of art!

data.name: G3L3_001
data.value: They should also be able to assist you with any trouble you may have.

data.name: G3L3_002
data.value: Once you capture the outlaw,[pause=10] bring them back to the guild for your reward from {0}.

data.name: G3L3_003
data.value: {0}![pause=0] We still have an outlaw to catch!

data.name: G3L3_004
data.value: Quickly![pause=0] To {0}!

data.name: G3L3_005
data.value: {0}![pause=0] We still have an outlaw to catch!

data.name: G3L3_006
data.value: Quickly![pause=0] To {0}![pause=0] We can do it this time!

data.name: G3L3_007
data.value: {0}![pause=0] We have to get back to {1}!

data.name: G3L3_008
data.value: Quickly![pause=0] To {0}![pause=0] We can't let Team [color=#FFA5FF]Style[color] get away with this!

data.name: G3L3_009
data.value: One for all...

data.name: G3L3_010
data.value: AND ALL FOR ONE!

data.name: G3L3_011
data.value: Alright Pokémon,[pause=10] let's get to the day's adventures!

data.name: G3L3_012
data.value: HURRAH!

data.name: G3L3_013
data.value: Wha-a-a-at's up,[pause=10] {0}?

data.name: G3L3_014
data.value: With Team {0}'s successful mission yesterday,[pause=10] I believe they are ready for an outlaw job.

data.name: G3L3_015
data.value: As you and {0} are the most experienced outlaw hunters in the guild...

data.name: G3L3_016
data.value: ...I would like the two of you to assist them in choosing their first job from the Outlaw Notice Board.

data.name: G3L3_017
data.value: What?[pause=0] You can't be serious,[pause=10] {0}!

data.name: G3L3_018
data.value: Why should we waste our time helping a bunch of newbies when we could be out catching outlaws ourselves!

data.name: G3L3_019
data.value: Of course,[pause=10] {0}![pause=0] We'd love to!

data.name: G3L3_020
data.value: We've been dying to show them the ropes of outlaw catching since they joined the guild!

data.name: G3L3_021
data.value: Isn't that right,[pause=10] {0}?

data.name: G3L3_022
data.value: Y-yup![pause=0] T-that's right![pause=0] We would love to help them with their first outlaw job!

data.name: G3L3_023
data.value: You know how much I love to teach others![pause=0] It's in my nature!

data.name: G3L3_024
data.value: Hahaha!

data.name: G3L3_025
data.value: Will do![pause=0] I ca-a-a-an't wait to see what outlaw they're gonna nab!

data.name: G3L3_026
data.value: Come on,[pause=10] you guys![pause=0] Let's get over to the Outlaw Notice Board!

data.name: G3L3_027
data.value: Um...[pause=0] Sure thing...[pause=0] We'll be right behind you.

data.name: G3L3_028
data.value: Coming,[pause=10] {0}?

data.name: G3L3_029
data.value: Uh-huh![pause=0] I'm r-right behind you,[pause=10] too!

data.name: G3L3_030
data.value: Thank you.[pause=0] Be sure to help them out in any way they may need.
